{{Quote|If you need an assistant, you need BR-3R! This little rabbit can help with any simple task!|Promotional description|<ref name="Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures (video game)">[[Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures (video game)|''Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures'']]</ref>}}
'''BR-3R''' was a [[LEP servant droid/Legends|LEP servant droid]] that was often used to assist [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] in the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Behind the scenes==
The designation of "BR-3R" and the fact that the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] was referred to as a "rabbit" were evocative of the character of [[Wikipedia:Br'er Rabbit|Br'er Rabbit]].
